correctness.rationale: A directed Euler tour of the 4-bit de Bruijn graph induces exactly one incoming/outgoing bijection at every vertex and vice versa when the induced 32-edge permutation is one cycle. All 2^16 bijection assignments are exhausted and independently matched against full edge-disjoint Euler DFS. Exactly 2048 canonical edge-00000-rooted tours result. Two mathematically different exact periodic autocorrelation implementations, direct ±1 products and set intersection R=4k-32, agree at every lag on every tour. Exact integer cross-histogram has 47 energy levels and mass 2048; means, variance and four-element extremizer symmetry orbits are recomputed by standalone verify.py and checked against the CSV. No extrapolation beyond order five.

value.rationale: Periodic integrated sidelobe energy is an established signal and autocorrelation quality invariant and is explicitly motivated by prior de Bruijn spreading-code work. The exact complete natural order-five population histogram and optimal-orbit classifications furnish a benchmark for energy selection, separate from the previously studied peak thresholds: within peak=8 alone, energy ranges 224 to 992. The finite scope is explicitly meaningful without asserting any downstream channel performance theorem.
